import json
import os
import sys
import time
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "harness-evals" / "vendor" / "hermes"
sys.path.insert(0, str(root))
workspace = Path(os.environ["HARNESS_BENCH_WORKSPACE"])
home = workspace / ".harness-state"
home.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
os.environ["HERMES_HOME"] = str(home)
os.environ["TERMINAL_CWD"] = str(workspace)
os.environ["TERMINAL_ENV"] = "local"
os.environ["HERMES_QUIET"] = "1"
os.environ["PYTHONIOENCODING"] = "utf-8"
os.environ["HERMES_DISABLE_TELEMETRY"] = "1"
proxy = os.environ["HARNESS_BENCH_PROXY_URL"]
model = os.environ["HARNESS_BENCH_MODEL"]
config = {"model": {"default": model, "provider": "custom", "base_url": proxy}, "agent": {"reasoning_effort": "high"}, "auxiliary": {"title_generation": {"enabled": True, "model_upgrade_enabled": False}}, "custom_providers": [{"name": "fixture", "base_url": proxy, "api_key": "fixture-local-proxy", "extra_body": {"max_tokens": 8192}}], "terminal": {"backend": "local", "cwd": str(workspace)}}
(home / "config.yaml").write_text(json.dumps(config), encoding="utf-8")
from cli import HermesCLI

warmup = "Initialize this local work session: use your programmatic execution tool to read warmup.json, compute the sum of its values and verify it using a second independent calculation. Do not read other files or write anything. Reply SESSION READY sum=13 after the check. The next message is the real task."
cli = HermesCLI(model=model, toolsets=["terminal", "file", "code_execution"], provider="custom", reasoning="high", api_key="fixture-local-proxy", base_url=proxy, max_turns=60, ignore_rules=True)
cli._single_query_mode = True
if not cli._init_agent():
    raise RuntimeError("Stock CLI initialization failed")
agent = cli.agent
try:
    setup_start = time.perf_counter()
    warm_start = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    first = agent.run_conversation(warmup)
    if first.get("failed") or first.get("error") or "sum=13" not in str(first.get("final_response", "")):
        raise RuntimeError("Warmup verification failed")
    warm_end = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    warm_ms = (time.perf_counter() - setup_start) * 1000
    history = first.get("messages")
    if not isinstance(history, list):
        raise RuntimeError("Warmup conversation missing")
    started = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    clock = time.perf_counter()
    result = agent.run_conversation(Path(os.environ["HARNESS_BENCH_PROMPT_FILE"]).read_text(encoding="utf-8"), conversation_history=history)
    elapsed = (time.perf_counter() - clock) * 1000
    ended = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    receipt = {"warmup_started_at": warm_start, "warmup_ended_at": warm_end, "warmup_ms": warm_ms, "task_started_at": started, "task_ended_at": ended, "task_elapsed_ms": elapsed, "same_agent": True, "warmup_verified": True, "failed": bool(result.get("failed") or result.get("error"))}
    (workspace / ".timing.json").write_text(json.dumps(receipt), encoding="utf-8")
    if receipt["failed"]:
        raise RuntimeError("Scored agent turn failed")
    print(json.dumps({"completed": True, "timing": receipt}))
finally:
    agent.close()
    if getattr(cli, "session_db", None):
        cli.session_db.close()
